items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: I always tell people I think Terry Gibbs summed it up perfectly when he said, “The man was crazy. The man was meshuga.”

ctx.x: Well there sure are a lot of Benny Goodman stories.

Oh God I’ve heard them, tons of them. And I can’t figure it out, why he was like he was. I always tell people I think Terry Gibbs summed it up perfectly when he said, “The man was crazy. The man was meshuga.”
I bet today there would be a designated psychological definition for what he was about.
